title: "MEA thermodynamics analyses"
subtitle: "Root Quarto website for the repository's retained analysis records"

This site traces the MEA–water–CO₂ thermodynamic model from retained source observations to parameter calibration and assessment. The [MEA parameter bundle](mea_parameter_bundle/notebook.qmd) is the main reading path for parameters, fitting plots and their limits.

On 2026-10-20 the owner adopted [A7](mea_parameter_bundle/notebook.qmd#working-record) and approved manuscript use. Its overview owns the adopted values and conditions; [joint calibration](mea_parameter_bundle/joint-recalibration/index.qmd) records the detailed evidence. Earlier records remain in the [parameter history](mea_parameter_bundle/results/parameter-record-history.csv).

The historical [independent chemical temperature study](mea_parameter_bundle/results/temperature-reanchor-140/stage-2/comparison-scores.csv) retains its own cohort scores, input identities and limits. It is separate from A7 adoption.

## Folder roles for parameter development

The physical folders stay with the result or source owner that created them.
The table below groups them by the role each record plays in reaching an
accepted parameter suite:

| Role | Folders and purpose |
|:--|:--|
| Parameter bundle | `mea_parameter_bundle/` — adopted parameter overview, formulation studies, coupled assessment, and historical bundle background. This is the only active parameter-development parent. |
| Reference and comparison | `six_species_solubility_reference/`, `neutral_pcsaft_pressure_reference/`, `ideal_reaction_equilibrium/`, and `paper_validation/2015_baygi/` — source-aligned baselines and parity checks used to define or assess candidates. |
| Historical and decision evidence | `historical_fixed_parameter_epcsaft_evaluation/`, `reactive_epcsaft_parameter_evidence/`, and `enrtl_six_species_ideal_comparison/` — completed configurations, packet-specific comparisons, and supported-negative gates. |
| Source and input-qualification records | `film_chemistry_work_package_a/` and `speciation_evidence_harmonization/` — qualified inputs and harmonization work that feed later studies but are not parameter authorities. |
| Retired exploration | `toybox/ionic_parameter_fit_playground/` — retained rejection record only; retain for traceability and exclude from promotion. |

The remaining records are source-qualification, reference, or audit analyses without
a hosted report. Their `README.md` and `analysis.yaml` files remain the source
records. Six-species, neutral-pressure, Baygi, speciation-harmonization, film,
and toybox records stay source-only; their values are linked from the pages that
use them rather than copied into new reports.

## Publication rules

- Render `analyses/_site/` with `bash render.sh` from `analyses/`; it syncs the
  sidebar and always passes `--no-execute`.
- Register a report with `python3 manuscript.py include . <report.qmd>
  --title <title> [--group <group>]`; an unregistered `.qmd` is not rendered.
- Keep evidence, scripts, and results in the analysis directory that owns them.
- Keep page front matter for content-specific metadata, shared presentation in
  `_quarto.yml`, and published-page and sidebar membership in
  `_cse-manuscript.json`.
- Keep `site.css` for shared publication layout and project-specific styling.
- Keep execution disabled for documentation builds. Numerical refreshes remain
  separate analysis commands with their own retained records and claim limits.
